title: X Mobs
name: x_mobs
short_description: Action-packed monsters, challenging bosses, swarm intelligence, and craftable 3D boss armor sets built for smooth performance.
long_description:
Bring your world to life with dangerous monsters, tactical boss encounters, natural creature swarms, and craftable 3D boss armor sets—all designed for smooth, responsive gameplay in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

## Gameplay & Features

- **Tactical Boss Fights & Unique Monsters**: Explore caverns, ancient forests, frozen wastes, and deep oceans guarded by distinct creatures and multi-phase bosses. Every enemy fights differently—spiders ambush from cave ceilings, stone titans rip boulders straight from the terrain, shamans and skeleton kings summon protective vanguards, and wounded bosses retreat behind their allies to recover.
- **Immersive Spells & Visual Status Effects**: Combat is clear and readable with 3D visual auras that wrap directly around affected players and creatures. Watch out for entangling forest roots, freezing ice cocoons, heavy earth gravity, and venomous bites—or turn those same powers against your foes.
- **Craftable 3D Boss Armor & Set Abilities**: Defeating flagship world bosses rewards you with rare armor drops and forging shards. Craft complete 3D armor sets and shields—**Titan Bastion**, **Glacial Frostborne**, **Skull Sovereign**, and **Crystalline Aegis**—and wear a matching armor set to unlock passive defensive wards and retaliatory boss effects in battle.
- **Lifelike Swarms, Packs & Ocean Schools**: Encounter insects that flock through the air, undead squads that coordinate in formation, and skeletal swordfish that school together in the open sea.
- **High Performance by Design**: Engineered to keep worlds running smoothly with lightweight creature AI, efficient animations, and event-driven combat effects that stay fast and responsive even on busy multiplayer servers.
